stemMd: A courier service predicts that giving dispatchers live road-closure information will reduce avoidable detours. Which evidence most strengthens the prediction?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Drivers know that detours can take longer.

options.label: B
options.textMd: A substantial share of current detours begins when dispatchers select roads that had already been officially closed, but whose closure they had not yet learned.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The service paints its vehicles uniformly.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The service operates on both weekdays and weekends.

explanationMd: The evidence shows a consequential information gap that live closure data can directly address. It connects the proposed tool to an identifiable source of avoidable detours.

distractorRationale.c: Vehicle appearance is unrelated to route information.
distractorRationale.a: Awareness of costs does not show the proposed data will prevent them.
distractorRationale.e: Operating days alone do not identify the mechanism.
distractorRationale.d: Lane count does not establish the information failure.
